title: User Onboarding: Add database schema, logic and api endpoints
description: Implements the core user_onboarding_state database table, backend logic in db/onboarding.py for querying tour status and unlock conditions, and GET/POST /1/user/<username>/onboarding API endpoints.

title: feat: Implement setup tour frontend infrastructure and TourModal
description: Frontend infrastructure stacked on PR #3764. Implements TourManager, SetupTourManager (using React Joyride), TourModal for start/resume/skip prompts, the useTour hook, and SCSS modal/tooltip styles.

title: feat: Add ListensTourManager, StatsTourManager, SocialTourManager
description: Stacked on PR #2 and PR #3764. Adds dedicated feature tour managers (ListensTourManager, StatsTourManager, and SocialTourManager) to guide users through player settings, stats charts, and social features.

title: feat: Add Feature Guide hub at /settings/feature-guide/
description: Stacked on PR #2, #3, and PR #3764. Implements the Feature Guide central dashboard at /settings/feature-guide/ where users can view, start, resume, or restart feature tours via custom browser events.
